sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Fixed `tests/support/snapshot.js`'s capture functions leaking this userscript's own injected `<script>` source into saved `rendered.html`/`raw.html` snapshots — opening a saved file directly in a browser showed the raw JS source dumped as literal page text (a `</script` substring inside the source prematurely closed the real script tag). Now strips every `<script>` element and inserts a `<base>` tag before serializing, matching `tests/support/test.js`'s existing precedent. Also switched `captureRaw()` from `domcontentloaded` to `load` — a native MusicBrainz page-JS widget was found racing that event, causing false diffs unrelated to any real change. Test tooling only; no userscript runtime changes.

sections.label: ⚙️ Internal
items: Added `performance.mark()`/`performance.measure()` instrumentation ('sa-fetch-phase'/'sa-render-phase') at `startFetchingProcess()`'s existing internal `fetchingTimeStart`/`renderingTimeStart` boundaries, readable via `performance.getEntriesByType('measure')` — backs the HTML-snapshot harness's `--perf` timing mode (`tests/support/capture-snapshots.js`). No sort-phase mark added — confirmed by reading the function that sorting never happens during the initial fetch/render, only later via a separate user-triggered column-sort click. Adds no UI and changes no user-visible behavior.

sections.label: ⚙️ Internal
items: Added the HTML-snapshot regression harness pilot (`tests/support/{snapshot,browser,capture-snapshots}.js`, `tests/pagetypes.json`), covering both `artist-releasegroups` and `release-tracks`: captures MB's raw page + the script's fully-rendered output, scrubbing known-volatile content (build-hashed asset URLs, this script's own self-reported timing text, and MusicBrainz's own per-request-randomized embedded JSON key order) before diffing against the committed baseline in `tests/snapshots/`. Also adds a `--perf` timing mode (5-sample median wall/stage timing vs. a committed baseline, 25%/3x warn/fail thresholds) and `tests/snapshots/registry.org`. Test tooling only; no userscript runtime changes.
